rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:9664:details:0: Welcome to the ⟦E42⟧, ⟦198⟧. As you know, the ⟦E43⟧ and their ⟦E44⟧ hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. The ⟦E45⟧ commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our ⟦E46⟧.
rows.quest:9664:details:1: Towers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
rows.quest:9664:progress:0: When the towers are under our control, we will soon be able to surround the ⟦E43⟧. After that, it is only a matter of time before we can crush them.
rows.quest:9664:completion:0: Very good, ⟦199⟧. It will be important for us to hold these towers against future attacks, and for that we may need your assistance until reinforcements can be brought in to secure the area.
rows.quest:9665:obj:0: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the ⟦E4⟧, then return to Emmisary Gormok at ⟦E3⟧.

Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
